_comment: Copy this file to system_config.json and fill in your values. system_config.json is gitignored.

x._comment_list_id: Your X/Twitter List ID. Find it in the URL: x.com/i/lists/<LIST_ID>
x._comment_cookies: Path to your X cookies JSON file. See INSTALL.md for how to export cookies.
x._comment_fetch_count: Number of tweets to fetch per scrape (max 100 recommended)
x._comment_retention_days: How many days to keep seen tweet IDs for dedup

discord._comment: OpenClaw Discord channel IDs for each output stream. Get IDs by right-clicking a channel in Discord (Developer Mode must be on).

data._comment: Where to store scraped data. Defaults to skill's data/ directory.
